patterned_stroke_reinterpretation.intentional_patterned_geometry: KEEP AS UNCERTAIN: test_periodic_pattern_is_uncertain_not_rejected does not authorize one continuous low-level primitive.
patterned_stroke_reinterpretation.minor_scan_dropout_safety: KEEP: test_short_isolated_dropout_does_not_automatically_reject protects a genuinely continuous degraded stroke.

records.assessment: Implementation behavior is not established as production-wrong by this test alone, but the test fixture/interpretation is semantically outdated because it supplies no positive degradation evidence.
records.current_assertion: A synthetic pair of separate collinear strokes with a 20 px blank gap is DIRECT_CONTINUATION_ADMISSIBLE / CLEAR_DIRECT_TRAJECTORY.
records.original_intended_safety_property: The admissibility decision is deterministic for a simple clear pair.
records.required_future_meaning: Use a continuous or positively degradation-supported fixture while retaining determinism; do not treat collinearity and a blank gap as restoration authority.

records.assessment: The no-semantic-filter safety property is correct; the test name and annotation-fixture interpretation conflate semantic neutrality with source continuity.
records.current_assertion: Object and annotation-tagged synthetic pairs remain admissible even though the annotation fixture contains a clear blank gap.
records.original_intended_safety_property: Candidate admissibility must not depend on object/annotation semantics or model evidence.
records.required_future_meaning: Retain semantic neutrality while avoiding any claim that a blank-gap source is one low-level continuous primitive.

records.assessment: The observability/no-model property is correct, but CLEAR_DIRECT_TRAJECTORY on a blank-gap fixture repeats the outdated restoration interpretation without positive degradation evidence.
records.current_assertion: The same 20 px blank-gap fixture reports CLEAR_DIRECT_TRAJECTORY and retains its gap measurement without model calls.
records.original_intended_safety_property: Decision reason and source measurements remain observable and model-independent.
records.required_future_meaning: Keep reason/evidence retention and model independence using a source-supported fixture or assert neutral serialization without treating the blank gap as continuous geometry.

records.assessment: Implementation and test semantics are compatible with the source-fidelity contract. PASS means preserved uncertainty, not permission to merge dashes.
records.current_assertion: A synthetic repeated dashed pattern is SPAN_INTEGRITY_UNCERTAIN, never supported as continuous geometry.
records.original_intended_safety_property: Patterned evidence stays conservative and does not become a destructive support/rejection decision.
records.required_future_meaning: Keep the explicit distinction from short scan-dropout tolerance.

records.assessment: Implementation and assertion are compatible; the old patterned-stroke safety summary must be read as preserved uncertainty, not destructive merge authority.
records.current_assertion: A dashed synthetic axis is PRIMITIVE_AXIS_UNCERTAIN (patterned or noisy/degraded), not axis-supported continuous geometry.
records.original_intended_safety_property: Do not misclassify patterned axis evidence as a hollow-center hard rejection or as confident continuous support.
records.required_future_meaning: Keep uncertainty and preserve visible component segments at low level.

records.assessment: This is the correct degradation-restoration safety meaning and is distinct from accepting intentional dashed geometry as one low-level primitive.
records.current_assertion: A two-pixel removal inside an otherwise solid synthetic stroke remains SPAN_INTEGRITY_SUPPORTED.
records.original_intended_safety_property: Minor scan/raster dropout must not automatically destroy a genuinely continuous source stroke.
records.required_future_meaning: Retain positive surrounding continuity evidence; do not generalize the result to arbitrary blank gaps.
